name: dx
description: Skills and CLIs for running coding agents in tmux and git worktrees: session lifecycle, parallel worktrees, tmux, memory, Codex, review and more

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Park idle Claude Code sessions in tmux to free memory and resume them with one keypress (cc-park), and hand a long session off to a fresh one through a written brief (fresh-session-handoff)

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: Run N Claude Code or Codex sessions in parallel git worktrees with a merged log (parallel-worktrees), contract-first fan-outs (contract-fanout), and branch stacking (stack-branches, stack-claude)
